'''Dooku's sleeping chamber''' was a bedroom of [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count of Serenno]], located in the main tower of [[Dooku's palace/Legends|his]] [[Castle/Legends|castle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]. It was very similar to the [[Dooku's throne room/Legends|throne room]], to which it was connected by a gangway. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Dooku was caught asleep in his bedroom when a group of [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] led by his former acolyte [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] infiltrated the castle to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] him.
